title: SIU investigates OPP shooting incident
article: Ontario's Special Investigations Unit (SIU) is probing the circumstances surrounding firearm injuries sustained by two men at an Old L'Amble Road residence in Bancroft early Saturday morning. The SIU invoked its mandate after two Bancroft OPP officers responded to a call for assistance at the home, just after 12:30 a.m., where "there was an interaction" with a 24-year-old man, said the SIU in a statement released Saturday afternoon. Sgt. Kristine Rae of the Ontario Provincial Police, said one of the officers was injured when the man picked-up a weapon and struck him. "The 24-year-old sustained multiple gunshot wounds when one of the officers discharged a firearm," stated the SIU. "A 49-year-old male in the home also sustained a gunshot wound to the arm." The three injured were taken to Kingston General Hospital for treatment and are listed by the SIU as being in serious, but stable condition. Shane Callow, 24, was charged with attempted murder. He remains in hospital in Kingston.

The SIU has assigned four investigators and two forensic investigators to probe the circumstances of this incident. Anyone who may have witnessed the incident is asked to contact SIU's lead investigator at 416-641-1872 or 1-800-787-8529 ext. 1872. More details will be posted here as they are made available.
